notes: Ensure that the changes to the planner prompt are precise and do not affect other functionalities. Verification of the changes is crucial to confirm compliance with the new requirement.

steps.description: Locate the current planner prompt file used at runtime
steps.details: Investigate the project directory structure and configuration files to identify the file that contains the planner prompt used at runtime.

steps.description: Modify the planner prompt to enforce 'python -m pytest' for all test commands
steps.details: Edit the planner prompt file to include a rule that explicitly states all test commands must use 'python -m pytest' and that 'pytest' alone is forbidden. Ensure this rule is clear and unambiguous.

steps.description: Verify the updated planner prompt by generating a new plan
steps.target: command to generate a new plan
steps.details: Execute the command or process that generates a new plan using the updated planner prompt. Ensure that the generated plan includes test commands using 'python -m pytest'.
